query_snapshot: What does NASA SP-8119 recommend consulting when selecting dissimilar metals for parts that touch, and what risk is this intended to address?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 recommends consulting the electrochemical series for metals when selecting dissimilar metals that will be in contact. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- That recommendation is intended to address galvanic (electrochemical) corrosion risk between dissimilar metals in contact. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
